$comment: The facts the agent-facing docs state, in one place. scripts/agent-docs.mjs fills them into agents/src/ templates; the service's facts test (flow-engineer/messaging, docs/context/customer/facts_test.go) fails when one differs from its code. The API version is read from openapi/openapi.yaml, never written here.

mcp.owner_rule: Adding the Flow MCP server to a developer's coding tools is the project owner's decision: suggest it and show them the command, but never add it to their config yourself.
mcp.runtime_rule: MCP is not a runtime dependency: the app you build talks to Flow through the REST API (or the SDK once published) for everything it does at runtime.

add.claude: claude mcp add --transport http flow https://api.flow.engineer/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_MESSAGING_KEY"
